exposure: cord blood inter-alpha inhibitor protein (IAIP) levels
cohort: The study included 57 newborns: a reference control group (uncomplicated term deliveries) and a moderate/severe HIE group (qualifying for therapeutic hypothermia), all born at >=36 weeks gestational age.
finding: Neonates with moderate to severe HIE exhibited significantly lower cord blood inter-alpha inhibitor protein (IAIP) concentrations compared to the control group.
